findings.title: saveAttemptEvaluation SALES_ADMIN override allowed cross-tenant writes
findings.description: The IDOR guard predicate was `attempt.userId === user.id || user.role === "SALES_ADMIN"`. The ownership check used the real attempt row's userId (good), but the admin branch allowed any SALES_ADMIN to mutate any attempt, including attempts owned by reps in a different school/tenant. Because salesRoleplayAttempts is REFERENTIAL (no schoolId), the admin branch needed an explicit users.schoolId scoping check. The existing Red test only exercised the not-found path (mock returned no rows), so the cross-tenant admin hole had no adversarial coverage.
findings.evidence: packages/domain/src/sales/mutations.ts:159 before fix: `if (existing.userId !== user.id && user.role !== "SALES_ADMIN")`. No tenant lookup for the admin branch. Plan comment claimed 'SALES_ADMIN whose tenant scoping is satisfied' but implementation did not satisfy it.
findings.fix_detail: Added a tenant-scoped users.schoolId lookup for the admin override path. The query runs through the tenant-scoped db (FLAT auto-injection) plus an explicit `owner.schoolId === tenant.schoolId` defense-in-depth check. Cross-tenant admin updates now throw SalesAuthError before any UPDATE. Also fixed the downstream markTheoryLessonComplete call to use the attempt owner's user context instead of the admin's context, so a passing evaluation updates the rep's progress, not the admin's.
tests_added: saveAttemptEvaluation rejects updating an attempt owned by another user (real ownership path)
saveAttemptEvaluation allows same-tenant SALES_ADMIN to update a rep's attempt

findings.title: saveAttemptEvaluation IDOR test exercised not-found path, not ownership path
findings.description: The original Red/Green test for IDOR configured the mock with no SELECT results, so the rejection came from the 'attempt not found' branch rather than the ownership-check branch. This left the real ownership predicate untested and masked the cross-tenant admin issue.
findings.evidence: packages/domain/src/__tests__/sales-authorization-idors.test.ts:63 original: `const db = createMockDb({ updateReturning: [otherAttempt] });` — selectResults defaults to [], so existing attempt is undefined.
findings.fix_detail: Updated the IDOR test to return the cross-owner attempt from SELECT so the rejection happens at the ownership predicate. Added same-tenant admin success and cross-tenant admin failure tests to cover the admin override branch.

findings.title: getCohortOverview relies on in-memory filter for REFERENTIAL salesProgress
findings.description: getCohortOverview fetches all salesProgress rows through the unscoped db and filters in memory against allowedRepIds derived from a tenant-scoped users query. The users query is FLAT and auto-scoped by TenantDB; the in-memory filter is defense-in-depth. In production this is sound because the users query returns only reps in the admin's tenant. The defensive filter is not masking a bug; it makes the output provably tenant-scoped even when TenantDB is bypassed in tests.

findings.title: Route-level consent/retention rejection tests were missing
findings.description: The audio-upload route validates size, MIME, duration, consent, and retention before arrayBuffer/storage/AI calls. Domain tests covered consent/retention rejection, but the route tests only covered size/MIME/duration, leaving the multipart form-data parsing of consent/retention without direct boundary coverage.
findings.evidence: apps/sales-advantage/app/api/roleplay-attempts/__tests__/audio-upload-boundary.test.ts originally had 3 tests; consent/retention were not explicitly tested at the route boundary.
findings.fix_detail: Added two route tests that verify missing/declined consent (null, 'false', '0', '') and invalid retentionDays (null, '', '0', '366', 'abc') each return 400 with the correct field and reach storage/AI/submit zero times. Verified the route parses only the exact string 'true' as consent and only a valid integer in [1,365] as retention.

findings.title: No raw PII/audio reaches provider without consent
findings.description: Both the route and domain enforce explicit affirmative consent (z.literal(true) at the domain; exact 'true' string parsing at the route) and bounded retention metadata before any storage.put or AI evaluate call. Rejected media reaches the provider 0 times.
findings.evidence: packages/domain/src/sales/mutations.ts:235-259 validates before evaluate. apps/sales-advantage/app/api/roleplay-attempts/route.ts:68-134 validates before arrayBuffer/storage/AI.

findings.title: audioStorageKey nullability and wire contracts verified
findings.description: Domain input/output schemas, types output schema, and Drizzle column all accept null audioStorageKey. The types package exports both roleplayAttemptInputSchema and roleplayAudioInputSchema for cross-app parity.

idor_guard_saveAttemptEvaluation.detail: Ownership check compares existing.userId from the SELECT result against user.id (not request input). Admin override is now tenant-scoped via users.schoolId. UPDATE is never invoked when ownership/tenant check fails.

cross_tenant_cohort_read.detail: Cohort overview scopes reps via FLAT users table (TenantDB auto-scope) plus explicit in-memory filter. Null tenant short-circuits to [].

audio_validation_order.route: size/MIME/duration/consent/retention validated before audioFile.arrayBuffer(), getStorageClient, getAIClient, getRoleplayEvaluationContext, and submitRoleplayAttempt.
audio_validation_order.domain: roleplayAudioInputSchema + explicit byte/duration checks run before createRoleplayAttempt, storage, or evaluate.

consent_retention_gate.detail: Consent must be the literal boolean true (domain) or exact string 'true' (route). retentionDays required and bounded [1,365]. No provider/storage calls on rejection.

provider_adapter_boundary.detail: No new raw-SDK bypass. Storage and AI are accessed only through getStorageClient and getAIClient adapters.

A2_consent_blind_publish_gate.detail: Audio publish/evaluation gate requires explicit affirmative consent and retention metadata. Tests verify rejection when consent or retention is missing/invalid.

A3_labeled_counts.detail: All count assertions use labeled variables: provider call count on rejected media, update call count, cross-tenant row count.

A6_registry_overstatement.detail: Plan claims 22/22 targeted tests pass and full suite passes. Verified: targeted gate exits 0 with 26/26 tests, full domain/api/sales-advantage suites pass. No 'resolved' marketing copy for unproven security states.
